wausau pd.name: Wausau Police Department
wausau pd.note: 20 cameras at city entry points; 233,355 vehicles sighted and 255 searches in 30 days as of Sept. 1, 2026, per a transparency portal Eyes On Flock has not indexed. Shares only with 205 Wisconsin agencies (opted out of nationwide sharing) and receives data from 183, one of them in Missouri; 30-day retention; 10-year contract

portal.prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, harassment or intimidation, actions based solely on a protected class (such as race, sex, or religion), and any personal use.

marathon county so.name: Marathon County Sheriff's Office
marathon county so.note: Publishes a transparency portal that Eyes On Flock has not indexed, linked from the county's own website: 10 cameras, 518,853 vehicles sighted and 204 searches in 30 days as of Sept. 1, 2026. Shares its data with 1,455 agencies in 40 states, including the FBI and two HIDTA task forces, and can search 866. The office joined ICE's 287(g) jail-enforcement program in early 2026; UW-Madison police said in July it was cutting Flock access for 287(g) agencies, and Marathon County still appeared on its sharing list at the time.

portal.prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, reproductive care enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
